nodes.label: Design system: coffee-brown + warm gold color palette
nodes.rationale: Adapted from a raw 'Coffee Shop' palette result; the raw #FEF3C7 cream was judged too saturated as a full-page background at dashboard scale, so it's reserved for accent surfaces only, with a lighter #FBF8F3 as the default page canvas.

nodes.label: Design system: typography (Playfair Display headings + Inter body)
nodes.rationale: The raw ui-ux-pro-max tool output (Fira Code/Fira Sans, Noto Serif/Sans JP) was manually rejected as wrong mood and unnecessary Japanese font coverage for a Russian-language app; Playfair Display and Inter both have full Cyrillic sets.

nodes.label: Design system: 3 layout patterns (public/marketing, client app, dashboard)
nodes.rationale: Dashboard pages (Master Dashboard, Admin Panel) use sidebar+main-content per reference screenshots; client task flows (booking, appointments, reviews) deliberately avoid a persistent sidebar as overkill for occasional-use single-task flows.

nodes.label: Design system: component specs (buttons, cards, inputs, status pills, toasts, skeletons, z-index scale)
nodes.rationale: Toasts auto-dismiss after 4s to satisfy the graded spec's '≤5s auto-dismiss' requirement; cards avoid scale-transform hovers to prevent layout shift.

nodes.label: Design system: anti-patterns list
nodes.rationale: Explicitly forbids emoji icons, forcing the raw tool's oversized-type 'Exaggerated Minimalism' landing pattern onto dashboard pages, a persistent sidebar on public/booking flows, full-page pure-cream backgrounds, scale-transform card hovers, submit-only validation, and non-auto-dismissing toasts.
